description: Record's small question dialogs (libadwaita alerts: a heading, optional body or text box, buttons; Enter takes the default button, Esc cancels): rename or create a notebook, delete a notebook, new page, delete a page, rename a chat.

parts.name: Rename (notebook)
parts.shows: Heading "Rename"; a text box holding the notebook's name (focused); buttons Cancel and "Rename" (suggested, default). A blank name changes nothing. Kept and the row and header bar's name change at once. Reached by: right-click a notebook → Rename…; key F2 in the notebooks list; the header bar's notebook name's tooltip says F2 too.

parts.name: New Notebook (naming)
parts.shows: As Rename but the heading is "New Notebook" and the suggested button is "Create". Shown right after + makes the notebook. Cancelling leaves the new notebook blank under its suggested name (it is dropped when left).

parts.name: Delete notebook
parts.shows: Heading "Delete {name}?", body "Its notes ({n} pages) go with it."; buttons Cancel and "Delete" (red). Then the first notebook is opened, or none. Reached by: right-click a notebook → Delete…; Meta's Delete {name}… button.
text: Its notes ({n} pages) go with it.

parts.name: New page
parts.shows: Heading "New page", body "Under {page}" when made from a page's menu (none when from the list's +); a text box (focused); buttons Cancel and "Add" (suggested, default). A name typed opens a tab of that page, made (as Parent:Name under a parent). Empty name does nothing.

parts.name: Delete page
parts.shows: Heading "Delete {page}?" (short name); buttons Cancel and "Delete" (red). Its tab closes; links to it stay and make the page again when followed; Meta's edits waiting on it are rejected.

parts.name: Rename chat
parts.shows: Heading "Rename chat"; a text box holding the chat's title; buttons Cancel and "Rename". Done the way Claude Code renames a chat (a custom-title line is added to its transcript), so Claude Code shows it too. The tab's title and tooltip, the Open a chat list and the saved list of open chats take it at once. Reached by: right-click a chat's tab → Rename….
